'''International relations'''
*[[Taiwan–United States relations]]
**[[Nancy Pelosi's Taiwan visit]]
***[[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|U.S. House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] arrives in [[Taiwan]] despite [[China|Chinese]] threats of military action in response to her visit. Pelosi is the most senior U.S. official to visit the [[self-governance|self-governing]] island since [[Newt Gingrich]] in 1997. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/pelosi-taiwan-china-us-1.6538434 (CBC)]
***The [[People's Liberation Army]] is placed on high alert and says that it will launch "targeted military operations" in response to Pelosi's visit to Taiwan. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china-launch-targeted-military-operations-due-pelosi-visit-2022-08-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**[[Abortion in Kansas]]
***[[2022 Kansas Value Them Both Amendment]]
****In the first [[referendum]] since the [[Supreme Court of the United States|Supreme Court]]'s decision to overturn ''[[Roe v. Wade]]'', [[Kansas]] voters reject [[2022 Kansas Value Them Both Amendment|an amendment]] in the [[Wyandotte Constitution|state constitution]] that would grant state lawmakers the ability to apply anti-abortion restrictions. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/kansas-2022-primary-election-results/story?id=87750747 (ABC News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-62402625 (BBC News)]
**In the first legal challenge to a state's [[abortion law]] since the [[Supreme Court of the United States|Supreme Court's]] June [[Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization|decision to overturn]] ''[[Roe v. Wade]]'', the [[United States Department of Justice|Department of Justice]] (DOJ) files a [[lawsuit]] in a [[Federal judiciary of the United States|federal court]] against the [[U.S. state|state]] of [[Idaho]] to block a state law that the DOJ says imposes a "near-absolute ban" on [[abortion in Idaho]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-sues-idaho-over-state-law-that-imposes-near-absolute-ban-abortion-court-2022-08-02/ (Reuters)]
